summary.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的「天光」皮肤：新海诚式日光观感，电影感开场与循环视频壁纸，支持上传、轮播、URL 与 ShaderToy GLSL 的壁纸库，可选 WebWallGL 场景壁纸、液态玻璃，以及可拖拽的薄荷猫桌宠（严格权限的 AI 对话、本地对话历史与可选自主思考）。Alt+W 打开壁纸面板。目前面向桌面端网页界面，未适配 DSH Go 原生界面。
summary.en: Tianlight skin for the DSH web GUI: a Shinkai-style daylight look with a cinematic opening film and a looping video wallpaper, a wallpaper library with upload, rotation, URL and ShaderToy GLSL sources, optional WebWallGL scene wallpapers, liquid glass surfaces, and a draggable Mint chibi-cat companion with permission-gated AI chat, local chat history and an optional autonomous-thinking loop. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel. Currently targeted at the desktop web GUI; not adapted to the DSH Go native interface.
